// PROBE FIXTURE for tests/unit/live-policy-status-filter.test.ts.
// The relation form of the bare-'active' bug: another model's query reaching
// the Policy table through `policy: { … }` and requiring exactly 'active'.
import { db } from "@/lib/db"

export async function probeBareActiveRelation(userId: string) {
    return db.gapInstance.count({
        where: {
            policy: { ownerUserId: userId, status: "active" },
            status: { in: ["open", "detected"] },
        },
    })
}
